stories.title: Radar makes podcasts searchable — and usable by AI agents
stories.simple_summary: A company called Particle made a tool that listens to over 130,000 podcasts, writes down what people say, and lets computers search through them and use that information.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech companies and investors — unless you run a podcast and want your content searchable, it doesn't directly affect you.

stories.title: Ex-Meta scientists want to bring visual AI to the factory floor
stories.simple_summary: Former Facebook scientists created an AI that helps factory robots see and understand their surroundings better, like giving a robot better eyes and a smarter brain.
stories.why_it_matters: This is for large manufacturers — if you run a small business, this isn't something you need to worry about right now.

stories.title: Bill Gates wants to see a robot tax and ‘Human Reserved’ jobs to mitigate harms from AI
stories.simple_summary: Bill Gates is suggesting ideas like a tax on robots and protecting certain jobs for humans only, to help manage problems that might come from artificial intelligence.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about future policy ideas — interesting to think about, but no immediate changes to your life yet.

stories.title: Surprise: Z.ai is the AI lab behind the mysterious Ox Alpha model
stories.simple_summary: A research group called Z.ai revealed it built a powerful AI model called Ox Alpha that performs very well, and the instructions for building it will be shared publicly soon.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to AI researchers and engineers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Robot brain builders are pushing out of their GPT-2 era
stories.simple_summary: Robot makers are working on giving their robots smarter artificial brains so they can do more complicated tasks.
stories.why_it_matters: This is technical progress that might eventually reach business or factory use — nothing immediate for you.

stories.title: QueryStory wants you to believe what AI is telling you
stories.simple_summary: A startup called QueryStory is using AI and computer security knowledge to make sure AI answers are accurate and trustworthy.
stories.why_it_matters: This is early-stage technology for companies wanting safer AI — mostly relevant to tech businesses and investors right now.

stories.title: Arga Labs is building a better way to train enterprise AI agents
stories.simple_summary: A company called Arga Labs raised money to build better tools for teaching AI assistants how to do specific business tasks.
stories.why_it_matters: This is funding news for investors — nothing that changes how you use AI.

stories.title: Hearing tech startup Legato emerges from stealth with $12M and a peek at its AI hearing glasses
stories.simple_summary: A startup made special glasses with built-in AI that help people hear better, similar to hearing aids but in eyeglass form.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have hearing difficulties, this might eventually be an option to explore, but it's still very new.

stories.title: Bill Gates is deeply worried about AI, and he’s no longer staying quiet
stories.simple_summary: Bill Gates, the Microsoft founder, wrote a long essay saying he's now worried about AI and its effects on the world, when he used to be more optimistic about it.
stories.why_it_matters: This is one person's opinion about the future — it's interesting to know how thoughtful people think about AI risks, but it doesn't change your situation today.

stories.title: Runable hits $21M to bet AI agents can go from building businesses to growing them
stories.simple_summary: A company called Runable is raising money with the idea that AI assistants can help small businesses not just start up but also grow and expand.
stories.why_it_matters: This suggests AI assistants might eventually help small business owners run their businesses better — worth paying attention to as these tools develop.

stories.title: India’s Ringg gets backing from Peak XV as it pushes voice AI past the phone call
stories.simple_summary: An Indian company called Ringg got funding to build voice AI that works beyond just phone calls, doing other things with spoken words.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly relevant to investors in India and tech enthusiasts — nothing immediate for your business.

stories.title: OpenAI says its Jalapeño chip can power faster AI responses than the competition
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI made a new computer chip called Jalapeño that makes AI systems answer questions faster and more efficiently than before.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about behind-the-scenes equipment that makes AI services run better — you might notice slightly faster responses from AI tools, but no action needed from you.
